body:
I've poked around at this, and there seems to be a precedent of it working correctly for boolean properties (like on WAV import):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b3e2378a-fd6f-4972-9560-8d2229527a23

This is the code that handles option visibility for the Texture importer:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fc827bbe256e47e1d7ec6945deb9c1e79724dac9/editor/import/resource_importer_texture.cpp#L188-L218

I've tried to change the `else if` to just `if` but that didn't fix it. I'm not sure how you can force option visibility to update after a property changes – the [WAV importer](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/fc827bbe256e47e1d7ec6945deb9c1e79724dac9/editor/import/resource_importer_wav.cpp) doesn't call anything like `update()` or `notify_property_list_changed()`, yet it works.

**Edit:** The rubber duck has spoken: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/104325
